name: compare-plans
purpose: The feature-by-feature matrix under the plan cards on Pricing: one column per plan with its name and action button pinned in the header while the page scrolls, one band per product with an overline, a title and a lead, and one row per feature saying what each plan includes — a tick, a dash, or the allowance as text. The recommended plan carries an accent bar, and below the large breakpoint the table folds to one plan picked from a select. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'compare-plans', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `select`, `button`, `overline`, `hint`, `tag` and `link`.
useWhen: On Pricing, under the plan cards, to show what every plan includes product by product.
avoidWhen: To compare Azion with a competitor → use `comparison-table`.
related: pricing-plans` — the plan cards this matrix sits under.
compare-support-tiers` — the same matrix for the Support page.
bestPractices: Give every plan a stable `id`; the narrow-screen picker selects by it.
Mark one plan `highlighted`; it gets the accent bar, the secondary button and opens the picker.
Give every row's `values` one entry per plan, in plan order.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a hash link can target it.

props.name: columnLabel
props.doc: Heading of the feature column, shown from the large breakpoint up.

props.name: pickerAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the plan picker shown below the large breakpoint.

props.name: includedLabel
props.doc: Screen-reader text of a ticked cell.

props.name: excludedLabel
props.doc: Screen-reader text of a dashed cell.

props.name: plans
props.doc: The plan columns, in order; each is `{ id, name, description?, highlighted?, action }` with `action` as `{ label, href }`; a plan without a name is dropped.

props.name: sections
props.doc: The product bands, in order; each is `{ eyebrow, title, description, rows, link? }` (`link` closes the band, `{ label, href }`) and a row is `{ label, values, group?, hint?, tag? }` with one value per plan: `true` or `✓` ticks, `—` dashes, other text shows as written, empty is blank.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: Closing link under the table, opened in a new tab; `{ label, href }`. Omitted when absent.

examples.name: Band links
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ComparePlans from '@aziontech/webkit/compare-plans'

  const plans = [
    {
      id: 'hobby',
      name: 'Hobby',
      description: 'For side projects.',
      action: { label: 'Start for free', href: '/signup' }
    },
    {
      id: 'pro',
      name: 'Pro',
      description: 'For teams in production.',
      highlighted: true,
      action: { label: 'Start trial', href: '/signup?plan=pro' }
    }
  ]

  const sections = [
    {
      eyebrow: 'Compute',
      title: 'Functions',
      description: 'Run code close to users.',
      rows: [
        { label: 'Requests per month', values: ['1M', '10M'] },
        { label: 'Custom domains', values: [true, true] },
        { label: 'Usage alerts', values: ['—', true] }
      ],
      link: { label: 'See compute rates', href: '/pricing/compute' }
    },
    {
      eyebrow: 'Storage',
      title: 'Object Storage',
      rows: [
        { label: 'Storage included', values: ['5 GB', '100 GB'] },
        { label: 'Versioning', values: ['—', true] }
      ],
      link: { label: 'See storage rates', href: '/pricing/storage' }
    }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <ComparePlans
    caption="Hobby and Pro compared feature by feature"
    column-label="Features"
    picker-aria-label="Plan being compared"
    included-label="Included"
    excluded-label="Not included"
    :plans="plans"
    :sections="sections"
  />
</template>
